result.title: CartoVec: General-Purpose Location Embeddings from Open Map Data
result.summary: Geographic coordinates are common inputs in applied machine learning, but latitude and longitude describe position rather than the surrounding environment. Image-grounded location encoders learn this context from satellite or ground-level imagery; structured open map data offers another source of supervision whose utility for continuous coordinate encoders remains less explored. We introduce CartoVec, a coordinate encoder trained to predict Overture-derived land cover, land use, transportation, place and connectivity targets at multiple spatial scales, without image inputs or downstream-task labels. We evaluate frozen embeddings on Census outcomes, Airbnb prices and Philadelphia crime in the US Northeast using spatial block cross-validation. CartoVec has the highest mean performance on most Census outcomes and the highest average across the full suite, with several comparisons close across folds. The findings support open map data as a practical source of reusable location representations with a coordinate-to-vector interface that requires no map lookup at inference. The open-weight model is available at https://huggingface.co/gursoyfurkan/CartoVec.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CartoVec：用 Overture 开放地图数据在多个空间尺度上预测土地覆盖、土地利用、交通、地点与连通性目标，训练一个无需图像输入和下游标签的坐标编码器，并在冻结嵌入上评估美国东北部的 Census、Airbnb 价格与犯罪率预测，推理时不需要地图检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多尺度结构化目标做无下游标签监督」与「冻结表示＋空间分块交叉验证」的协议，可能可供核查能否迁移到 VLM 内部视觉状态的多尺度空间/关系信息保留与 latent 质量评估上。
